Bash("C:/Program Files/Autodesk/Maya2025/bin/mayapy.exe" -c "
import maya.standalone
maya.standalone.initialize\(name=''python''\)
import maya.cmds as cmds

# Create a simple plane along XZ, with known UV layout
# polyPlane default: width along X, height along Z
# UV: U along X, V along Z
plane = cmds.polyPlane\(w=10, h=10, sx=1, sy=1, ax=[0,1,0]\)[0]
shape = cmds.listRelatives\(plane, shapes=True\)[0]

# Create uvPin at center
pin = cmds.createNode\(''uvPin'', name=''test_pin''\)
cmds.connectAttr\(f''{shape}.worldMesh[0]'', f''{pin}.deformedGeometry''\)
cmds.setAttr\(f''{pin}.coordinate[0].coordinateU'', 0.5\)
cmds.setAttr\(f''{pin}.coordinate[0].coordinateV'', 0.5\)

# Test different tangentAxis/normalAxis settings
for tan_ax in range\(3\):
    for norm_ax in range\(3\):
        if tan_ax == norm_ax: continue
        cmds.setAttr\(f''{pin}.tangentAxis'', tan_ax\)
        cmds.setAttr\(f''{pin}.normalAxis'', norm_ax\)
        m = cmds.getAttr\(f''{pin}.outputMatrix[0]''\)
        # Extract axes from output matrix
        x_axis = \(m[0], m[1], m[2]\)
        y_axis = \(m[4], m[5], m[6]\)
        z_axis = \(m[8], m[9], m[10]\)
        print\(f''tan={tan_ax} norm={norm_ax} -> X={[round\(v,2\) for v in x_axis]} Y={[round\(v,2\) for v in y_axis]} Z={[round\(v,2\) for v in z_axis]}''\)
")
